help.minimum: The least a buyer may order of one product. An order below it is refused with the nearest valid quantities named — nothing is ever rounded up for them.
help.multiple: The step size. With a multiple of 24 a buyer orders 24, 48 or 72 — never 30. Steps count up from the minimum, so a minimum of 50 in steps of 24 allows 50, 74 and 98.
help.order_minimum: The least a whole order must come to, counting items only — delivery and tax do not help reach it. Buyers see how far short they are while they shop, and checkout is refused until they reach it.
